benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible purchases against theft or accidental damage for 120 days from purchase (90 days for New York residents), up to $1,000 per claim and $50,000 per account per calendar year.
benefits.terms: Last known terms prior to card discontinuation. Dollar caps corroborated by a single secondary source (Fit Small Business); not independently verified against Amex's own cardmember agreement PDF, which could not be machine-read.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Adds up to 2 additional years of coverage on eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 5 years or less.
benefits.terms: Last known terms prior to card discontinuation.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss & Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Covers damage or theft of a rental car when the entire rental is charged to the card and the rental company's collision damage waiver is declined.
